intro: Technology and cybersecurity organisations bore the brunt of 65 ai-security articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-08-03, with critical infrastructure, government, and financial services also frequently affected. The coverage recorded 31 high-severity and 8 critical incidents, spanning global, United States, China, and North America regions. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed in these reports. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 7.7), and CVE-2026-45303 (CVSS 7.7). The archive also contains 14 informational and 6 medium items.
